candidate: First substantive C4 source that passes directed correctness; commit exact runtime before the invocation and record both commit and runtime SHA256.
query_order: Same deterministic fixed order for each source pair; record every original query ID in every worker.
cache: Native MemoryBook cache_size=0 and use_cache=False. No new result or persistent feature cache.
timing: Complete native recall, excluding post-call hash validation. Fresh worker per source/cohort/round; retain all cells, calls, errors and adverse results.
correctness: Every complete payload except latency_ms matches the published baseline. Unchanged source/index projections and exact count/invariant checks from the retained development helper.
attempt_policy: One registered invocation for this substantive C4 source. Never discard or replace adverse rows. If correctness fails, retain the failed result before any substantive fix; a corrected source requires a new explicitly identified attempt.
decision_boundary: Development diagnosis on old regression cohorts, not formal release acceptance and not an MCP/competitor/new-quality claim. The separate fixed 56,784-call bound run must pass every original gate.
